article.title: La libertà dei rami
article.epigraph: J. W. von Goethe, Das Göttliche, vv. 31–35

it: Mandelbrot e la misura di una costa
Che cosa si può dedurre dalla regola di Koch?
Da una gemma alla chioma del faggio
Come un bronco raggiunge la terza dimensione
Sul lato da cui arriva la corrente
Da dove vengono i sei bracci di una stella di neve?
en: Mandelbrot and the length of a coastline
From a bud to the crown of a beech
How an airway branches into the third dimension
On the side facing the current
Where do the six arms of a stellar snow crystal come from?

verification.originalAssets: All previously released public files and CV.pdf match the 3.28.0 source archive byte for byte.
verification.zipIntegrity: ZIP directory, CRC and per-file SHA-256 checked against the packaged contents.
verification.offlinePreviews: An isolated npm run preview:build generated both self-contained HTML files (35 pages per language). Both have the blog route, complete fractal essay, all 16 numbered plates, measuring diagram, 12 references, inline images, and valid CSP hashes for the embedded scripts and styles. Both complete scripts passed Node’s syntax check. These checks cover the generated files and do not assert browser interaction.
verification.browser: Managed Chrome preview: entered the site from the Italian home page, opened the article through the blog and checked Goethe’s attribution. The coastline divider returned 171.7, 183.9 and 199.4 km in Italian. Switched to English, verified the localized 199.4 km reading and changed the Koch slider by keyboard; step two showed 16 segments.
